=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_smoke_alert_silencing_contract.py:96 (test at 168-170) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds a step-level ALERT_MSG_LEVEL declaration at .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:288. The workflow now has 12 declarations (lines 288, 982, 1262, 1297, 1314, 1335, 1562, 1728, 1767, 1841, 2121, 2260), but the pin lists 11 and the comment at lines 93-95 omits the new step.
  WHY: The assertion fails, matching the CI log for tests-promote-stall-and-review. Fix: change `* 11` to `* 12` and update the comment.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_release_stall_alert` slot check and `stall_today` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: README documents MERGE_TRAIN_STALL_ALERT_HOUR_UTC as 0-23. With 22 or 23, the 3-hour slot crosses UTC midnight and the once-a-day note is keyed by UTC date.
  WHY: Ticks before and after 00:00 UTC see different alert_date values, so a queued PR can get two warnings in one slot. This is unlikely given the default of 1 and no repo variable.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_release` (release_oldest_pr at ~1599-1603; alert call at ~1707-1710) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The alert candidate is the oldest queued PR seen before processing. If it is released in the same pass, the warning is skipped for the whole pass although other aged PRs remain queued.
  WHY: The daily warning can be missed for that tick. The next tick picks the new oldest PR, so the delay is bounded.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_release_stall_alert` stall_slot_hour validation. Treat hours above 21 as invalid and fall back to 1, or document the limit in README (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:288; tests/test_smoke_alert_silencing_contract.py:96 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new step-level ALERT_MSG_LEVEL declaration raises the count in orchestrate_poll.yml from 11 to 12, but the contract test still pins 11.

- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1599-1603, 1671-1672, 1707-1710 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The alert candidate is chosen before release processing and is suppressed only if that same PR was dispatched. If the oldest PR is released while another old PR remains queued, the alert is skipped. If dispatch and queue-label restoration both fail, the candidate can be alerted although it is no longer queued.
  WHY: The warning can miss a still-queued over-threshold queue or report a PR no longer labelled ai:merge-queued.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1469-1476, 1507-1510 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The three-hour slot supports start hours through 23, but the once-per-day marker uses the current UTC date. A slot starting at 22:00 or 23:00 crosses midnight and changes the marker date mid-slot.
  WHY: With a five-minute poll cadence and a start hour of 23, a warning sent before midnight can be sent again after midnight in the same slot.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- tests/test_smoke_alert_silencing_contract.py:96 (test at lines 168-170) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds a 12th step-level ALERT_MSG_LEVEL declaration to orchestrate_poll.yml (line 288, "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train backstop)"), but EXPECTED_STEP_DECLARATIONS still pins 11. _step_declarations (STEP_DECL_RE, line 102) now collects 12 entries: lines 288, 982, 1262, 1297, 1314, 1335, 1562, 1728, 1767, 1841, 2121, 2260.
  WHY: CI job tests-promote-stall-and-review (run 42741082452) fails; counting `^\s+ALERT_MSG_LEVEL:` matches gives 12 against a pin of 11. Fix: change `* 11` to `* 12` and extend the comment at lines 89-95.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1707-1710 (alert call), 1599-1602 (candidate capture), 1674-1691 (dispatch-failed path) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stall-alert candidate is the oldest label-bearing PR captured before release processing, and is excluded only when it was itself released. So the daily warning is skipped for that pass if the oldest PR is released while another aged queued PR remains. If dispatch and label restoration both fail (lines 1676-1691), that PR stays the candidate and still counts in `examined - released`, so the note's "oldest of N ... still labelled `ai:merge-queued`" claim is wrong for it.
  WHY: The warning can name a PR without the queue label or miss the remaining queue for a pass. Release, label and dispatch decisions do not depend on the alert (fail-open), so impact is limited to message accuracy.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1469-1477 (slot check and stall_today); README.md "Queue-age warning" section documenting 0-23 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: With MERGE_TRAIN_STALL_ALERT_HOUR_UTC at 22 or 23, the 3-hour slot spans 00:00 UTC. stall_today (line 1474) changes mid-slot, so the date-keyed note check (lines 1509-1511) treats the post-midnight tick as unalerted.
  WHY: A still-queued PR gets a second Telegram warning in the same slot, contradicting the "one Telegram WARNING a day" contract. It is reachable only via the documented 0-23 range, and the default of 1 keeps it dormant. Fix: treat hours above 21 as invalid and fall back to 1, or document the wrap.
- UNMAPPED CI FAILURE: check-run `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` failed with `Error: Prompt too big after adding system message (errorCode: custom_instructions_too_large, statusCode 422)`. No diff hunk is implicated; this is an external reviewer-agent capacity failure.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/review_merge_train.sh lines 1469-1472. Reject hours above 21 (e.g. `[ "$((10#${stall_slot_hour}))" -gt 21 ]`) (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
